title: The Monastery Orchard

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: The apple trees in our orchard are heavy with fruit! The brothers need help picking.

intro.speaker: elias
intro.text: We store them in trays of five, so they don't bruise. Will you fill the trays?

steps.speaker: elias
steps.prompt: Put five apples on each tray. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a tray with an empty dip, and put an apple there.

older.prompt: Ten apples on each tray, four trays. No dips to help: count in tens.

feedback.full: That tray is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four trays of five: twenty apples, not one bruised!

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Twenty apples! The brothers will make cider and pies, and keep some for the winter.

journal_line: I picked apples in the monastery orchard.

outro.speaker: elias
outro.text: Four trays of ten: forty apples! A bountiful year.
